svg.title: Inside an organisation, in a miniature of Sullivan's Guaranty Building
svg.desc: Thirteen exterior tiers of the Guaranty Building, interpreted in five conceptual sections. The interiors show coral-coloured people in suits working alongside blue mesh robots. Scrolling lifts each section to reveal executive decisions, teams, work processes, systems and research. Small coral and seaweed sprigs grow around its base.

g.data-name: Fine seaweed at the left corner
Small branching coral behind the right corner
Short seaweed on the front left edge
Small coral sprig on the front right edge
One small seaweed shoot at the front edge
